limitations: Not actual OpenAI input/output, reasoning, cached or billed usage.
Excludes hidden prompts, images, internal reasoning and context replay.
Laya tokens use a different tokenizer and are reported separately.
Elapsed is init through original execution finish, including pauses and cold model load. Later human QC wait is reported separately when recorded.
Only sanitized aggregates are exported; raw local logs remain private.
Only one pair is complete; this is descriptive evidence, not a savings or causal claim.
Both transcript captures remain complete:false; log completeness is unverified.
Baseline retained preparation context; hybrid used a fresh task. Context replay differs.
Baseline used CLI steps for navigation; hybrid used native browser setup/navigation/download-menu controls. Navigation overhead is not controlled.
Human QC was accepted after execution finish. Parent coordination and later QC bookkeeping are outside both execution/token windows.

runs.transcript_source: Local JSONL response items timestamped between run init and finish; user/assistant visible text and tool arguments/outputs only. Excludes system, developer, reasoning, images and event summaries. Log completeness is unverified.

comparison.reason: requires exactly six registered attempts; do not drop failures or retries

limitations: Host-reported telemetry; not verified against a provider bill or usage API.
Records are selected by timestamp, not a provider request start/end interval.
Input includes context replay; cached input is a subset, not extra tokens.
Reasoning output is a subset of output; no reasoning content is exported.
Setup context can be replayed during the run and confound comparisons.

execution_provenance.ui_mode_source: User-confirmed Work locally workflow; UI model picker not independently observed
execution_provenance.task_origin: Created with app task tool after explicit user request; same saved local project and requested model/effort

artifact.qc_review_source: User accepted complete 16-second playback, mug/hand proportions, continuity and Thai dialogue

benchmark_inputs.hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON shots array with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false and compact separators

post_execution_qc.timing_note: Original execution elapsed and finish event preserved; post-execution human review wait is separate.
post_execution_qc.receipt_timing_source: Original monotonic execution elapsed plus UTC difference between original finish event and explicit user reply timestamp

execution_details.ui_warning: After second submission UI displayed credit exhaustion/Not enough credits while accepted render progressed. Both shots subsequently downloaded. No further submission.
execution_details.native_browser_note: Read/settings/account and deterministic download navigation performed by ChatGPT with visible controls and recorded events. Laya selected fill and submit for both shots. No native generation click.
execution_details.laya_calibration_warning: Checkpoint temperature clamp warning retained in delegation stderr; confidence not used to claim quality.
execution_details.setup_note: Pre-init model check excluded from elapsed; two cold model loads during the measured run are included. Ready-for-review is a supplemental marker, not the comparison boundary.
